milestone_full: Layer S continues: 191 Hong Kong chapters in three arms, atlas lockstep 191/191/191 with a derived fence. Three curated arcs are walkable from any chapter — the ticket arc (179-183), the crossing arc (64-67) and the eight-stop timetable arc (184-191, one folded sheet from the Central terminus through Wan Chai and North Point, onto the ferry, ashore at Central and into the iron box of unfinished sheets). A measured world census states the real size; the seven-layer census derives 17/20/18/21/10/10/10 from the 106 curated clock chips; the hub offers a continuation rail past the 106-chapter clock, the stamp tracker collects all 191 chapters, and the newest cards carry teaching tooltips. Both authoring planes were browser-verified with zero console errors. Production-limit siege: 2,702 stuffing requests ALL 429 at p50=25 ms, zero 5xx; production read plane 512/512 at 64-way concurrency. Spring Cloud edge, 12 StateGraph lanes, admin behavior analytics (password 123) with a real funnel, embedded in-app handbook, contract-enforced English arm. D1577 removed the Clash Verge dependency; outbound egress is direct. The gpt-6.2-sol API is closed by directive. verify_all NO OFFENDER, 1040 web + 38k AI green.

privacy_note: All consumer fixtures are synthetic (demo flags); no real merchant, stall or operator is represented. /insights replay is deterministic synthetic inference, not stored user data. All REAL-HK figures are public sources with URLs inline on the handbook page.
milestone_full_zh: Layer S 持續：191 章香港系列三語臂，圖譜鎖步 191/191/191，圍欄由索引推導。三條策展弧可從任一章走完——票之弧（179–183）、渡之弧（64–67）、八站時刻表之弧（184–191，一張摺了三折的紙由中環終點站經灣仔、北角上渡輪、中環上岸，最後放進裝著沒寫滿的紙的鐵盒）。世界普查實測規模；七層明細由 106 個時辰格算出 17/20/18/21/10/10/10；主站有 106 章之後的續走軌道，印章追蹤器收集全部 191 章，新卡片都有教學提示。雙語瀏覽器實測零報錯。生產級攻城：2,702 發撞庫全數 429、零 5xx；生產讀面 64 路並發 512/512。Spring Cloud 邊緣、12 條 StateGraph、密碼 123 管理員漏斗、嵌入式說明書、契約強制英文臂。D1577 移除 Clash Verge 依賴，出站直連；API 已按指令關閉。verify_all 全綠，web 1040＋AI 38k 全綠。
